ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Application_Status__c ), ISPICKVAL(Application_Status__c , "Reviewed"), OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Application_Status__c )) = "Incomplete", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Application_Status__c )) = "Completed" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the status from Incomplete or Completed to Reviewed.
